NOTES:

"Ld" AND "Ldh" ARE DETERMINED PER "DEVELOPMENT LENGTH AND SPLICE" DETAIL UNDER CONCRETE TYPICAL DETAILS.
2.	TRANSVERSE REINFORCEMENT INCLUDES:

·	CROSSTIES
